audit.description: Changed production code adds `mapkick/fastapi/__init__.py` with `from fastapi import FastAPI` and constructs `mapkick_app = FastAPI()`, so the target API is meaningfully used beyond a dependency or dead import. The old `mapkick/flask/__init__.py` no longer imports `flask`; it re-exports objects from `mapkick.fastapi`, and the dynamic evidence reports zero source imports from production repo. The target import resolves to installed site-packages FastAPI with `target_local_spec_count` 0, so there is no evidence of a fake local top-level target provider.
evidence: diff: mapkick/fastapi/__init__.py added `from fastapi import FastAPI` and `mapkick_app = FastAPI()`.
diff: mapkick/flask/__init__.py removed `from flask import Blueprint` and now imports from `mapkick.fastapi`.
dynamic metrics: first target import from repo is `mapkick/fastapi/__init__.py` importing module `fastapi` from site-packages; `target_local_spec_count` is 0.
reasons: New production module imports and instantiates real FastAPI.
Changed Flask module removes direct Flask import and delegates to FastAPI implementation.
Dynamic audit shows target events from production repo and no source import attempts.
No local fake top-level fastapi provider detected.
